name: remote-work-new-joiner
scenario: A new employee who joined last month asks about working from home.
expected_outcome: The bot explains the 90-day probation, the 2-days-per-week limit after it, and the VPN requirement.
user_turns: I joined the company last month. Can I work from home?
Once I'm eligible, how many days a week can I do it?
Do I need anything special set up on those days?

name: leave-carry-over
scenario: An employee asks what happens to unused annual leave.
expected_outcome: The bot explains that up to 5 days carry over and anything beyond that is forfeited.
user_turns: I have 3 unused annual leave days. Will I lose them at year end?
What if I had 8 unused days instead?

name: business-trip
scenario: An employee plans a 4-hour flight to visit a client.
expected_outcome: The bot confirms economy class, the $200 hotel limit, the $60 meal allowance and the 30-day claim deadline.
user_turns: I'm flying 4 hours to visit a client next week. Can I book business class?
How long do I have to submit my receipts afterwards?

name: sick-leave-name-recall
scenario: Priya tells the bot her name and that she will be off sick for 5 days.
expected_outcome: The bot tells Priya a doctor's note is required because 5 days is more than 3, and remembers her absence length.
user_turns: Hi, I'm Priya. I'll be off sick for 5 days starting tomorrow.
Do I need anything from my doctor?
Remind me, how long did I say I'd be off?
